# State Management Checklist: SPEC-011 CrabTrap Honeypot Adapter

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are feature-flag state requirements complete for central registration, default-off behavior, workspace JSON opt-in, and `resolveFlag('FEATURE_CRABTRAP_HONEYPOT', ctx)` gating? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-017, Constitution §V]
- [x] CHK002 Are no-op state requirements defined for feature-disabled, missing-config, and invalid-config paths, including zero activity writes and no CrabTrap runtime requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK003 Are replay and idempotency state requirements complete without adding a replay table, including adapter-derived `data.replay_key_hash` and selected workspace/facility activity lookup? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Replay Identity, Data Model §ReplayIdentity]
- [x] CHK004 Are accepted activity state requirements documented for exactly one existing-schema `activities.type='security_intrusion_detected'` row per accepted unique denial summary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec §SC-002, Data Model §SecurityActivityEvidence]
- [x] CHK005 Are non-mutation requirements complete for scheduler, task-dispatch, task-chain, runner, sandbox, GitHub sync, notifications, task terminal state, successor selection, OpenAPI, and UI surfaces? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-014, Data Model §State Transitions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the feature-flag context requirement clear that environment values do not force the CrabTrap flag on and that workspace JSON is the opt-in state source? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Constitution §V]
- [x] CHK007 Are `noop`, `rejected`, `accepted`, and `failed` intake result states clearly separated by activity-write effects and bounded failure codes? [Clarity, Data Model §CrabTrapIntakeResult, Data Model §State Transitions]
- [x] CHK008 Is replay identity defined with exact source fields, delimiter, hash format, and the rule that the adapter derives the persisted replay key after validation? [Clarity, Spec §Replay Identity, Data Model §ReplayIdentity]
- [x] CHK009 Is activity landing scope unambiguous for approved workspace context, facility workspace fallback, and project id stored only as bounded activity data? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §CrabTrapAdapterContext]
- [x] CHK010 Are activity-write failure requirements clear that `activity_write_failed` is a bounded failed state, not a trigger for retries, task updates, notification fanout, or broader runtime state changes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-014, Data Model §CrabTrapIntakeResult]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Can feature-disabled and missing/invalid-config no-op behavior be objectively measured as zero CrabTrap activity rows and unchanged unrelated workflows? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK017 Can accepted-state behavior be objectively measured as exactly one `security_intrusion_detected` activity row for each unique signed fixture? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK018 Can replay/idempotency behavior be objectively measured as zero new activity rows for duplicate source/event/timestamp combinations in the selected landing scope? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §ReplayIdentity]
- [x] CHK019 Can no-scheduler/task-dispatch/task-chain mutation be objectively measured from final diff or guardrail proof against the explicit forbidden surfaces? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Spec §FR-018, Plan §Validation Plan]
- [x] CHK020 Can activity-write failure isolation be objectively measured without depending on a retry queue, new persistence table, task mutation, notification row, route, or scheduler state? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Validation Plan]
